deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - MCM004 Medicare Indiv - R12 Period (202505-202604)

detail_statements: Out of Total claims count 1,591,729, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 7.16% and PMPM ratio increased by 39.55% for R12 period.
In NJ, out of 1,591,729 total claims (for R12), 1,077,649 (67.70%) were NPAR, resulting in $245,481,058.41 in OON payments.

In NJ, out of 50,220 total NPAR claims for Provider PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS, LLC under the DSNP HMO product, 0.03% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In NJ, IDR claims represented 0.00% of total OON claims. No IDR activity was observed during the R12 period.
Out of Total claims count 1,177,649, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 26.39% and PMPM ratio increased by -27.34% for R12 period.
In VA, out of 1,177,649 total claims (for R12), 1,001,781 (85.07%) were NPAR, resulting in $235,411,818.81 in OON payments.

In VA, out of 14,062 total NPAR claims for Provider HOPE IN HOME CARE LLC under the DSNP HMO product, 0.11% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In VA, IDR claims represented 0.00% of total OON claims. No IDR activity was observed during the R12 period.
Out of Total claims count 828,211, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 5.49% and PMPM ratio increased by -30.74% for R12 period.
In CA, out of 828,211 total claims (for R12), 651,024 (78.61%) were NPAR, resulting in $945,736,194.10 in OON payments.

In CA, out of 4,907 total NPAR claims for Provider KWPH ENTERPRISES under the DSNP HMO product, 0.97% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In CA, IDR claims represented 0.00% of total OON claims. No IDR activity was observed during the R12 period.

PYRAMID HEALTHCARE NEWPORT NEWS shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
DRG 897 (Alcohol, Drug Abuse or Dependence without Rehabilitation Therapy without MCC) accounts for approximately 89% of total OON reimbursements for PYRAMID HEALTHCARE NEWPORT NEWS.

PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS, LLC shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for similar member populations and professional service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
All DRGs for PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS, LLC are classified as NOT_MAPPED; DRG-level breakdown is not available for this provider.

detail_statements: During the same R12 period, NPAR claim volume and associated paid amounts increased for BEN TAUB HOSPITAL, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.

During the same R12 period, NPAR claim volume and associated allowed/paid amounts increased for PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS, LLC, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.
No IDR claims were observed for any provider during the R12 period for Medicare Indiv LOB.
